requirement_reviews.observations: Slender exposed leg links and compact torso read as a light scout; function is design intent, not runtime proof.
Exactly two complete legs are visible.
Main torso silhouette is spherical, not a cuboid.
Exactly two lateral forward gun housings are visible.
Teal illuminated strips establish the adopted energy-weapon visual language; operating technology unproven.
Leg assembly from hip to foot is substantially taller than torso diameter.

quality_reviews.observations: All six extracted required constraints reviewed.
Sphere, paired guns and long legs distinct against neutral gray.
Visible hip/knee/ankle interfaces support construction planning; stroke, loading and balance not established.
Full unobscured body, joints and feet visible; rear remains uncertain.
Sparse shell paneling; no wear clutter, limited small mechanisms.

consistency_checks.observations: All four panels retain spherical scout body, paired side guns and long thin legs.
Overall envelope similar, but side knee bend/pose and projected leg spacing are not a metrically comparable pose.
Front/rear/3/4 depict two legs and paired guns; side occlusion expected, but outer front-left and 3/4-right gun are cropped.
Rear disk/paneling and backside joint details are invented hypotheses; amber uncertainty marking requested but absent.
Antenna appears image-right front and image-left rear; side forward guns and top sensor orientation broadly correspond. No hidden axis proof.
Main spherical mass, long legs and two short lateral gun housings preserve macro read.
